forum.title: Question about the STM32 HAL SPI driver
forum.best_answer_content:
HAL does nothing really mystic here.

For each  SPI you have one DR register. Writing to this register transmits the written value to the transmit buffer, while reading the register copies a value from the receive buffer as described in RM0430 file:///home/klwa4731/Downloads/rm0430-stm32f413423-advanced-armbased-32bit-mcus-stmicroelectronics.pdf (section 29.3.9).

The transmission itself is handled in HW, regardless of HAL or LL or nothing at all is used.

HAL just covers finding the register by accessing it through the handle (and maybe hides differences between STM32 variants).
